symptom: with native mobile widget packages installed, `check` reports `image img1 (Image: …)` "has no property Image [MDL-WIDGET01]" and validates `radiobuttons` against the native RadioButtons, while exec writes a Forms$RadioButtonGroup
cause: DeriveMDLName took only the last id segment, so `widget init` wrote image.def.json / radiobuttons.def.json for com.mendix.widget.native.*; the registry let a user def of a DIFFERENT widget id replace a built-in name (info log only), and check resolves keywords through the registry while the builder's switch owns `radiobuttons` before any lookup
insight: Fixing only the init-time name leaves the bad files already on users' disks, so the guard has to sit where definitions are loaded: refuse a different-id def under a built-in or builder-owned keyword, keep it reachable by id. The builder-owned keyword set is pinned to buildWidgetV3's switch by a go/ast test, so check and exec cannot drift again. DESCRIBE needed nothing: pluggableWidgetHeader already round-trips the name through Get and falls back to `pluggablewidget '<id>'`
